raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer hallucinated specifics by claiming Britannica indicated Jefferson Davis “served as a lieutenant” in the Mexican-American War and asserting an exact end-of-service date of May 30, 1848 without extracting that from the source. This conflated the war’s treaty ratification exchange date with Davis’s personal end of fighting (his regiment mustered out in 1847) and introduced an unsupported, overly specific date, leading the team toward an incorrect/unsupported conclusion.
